title: wards/ward-NN.json — one ward's full detail
description: See build_ward_file() in pipeline/emit_api.py. alderman and alderman_note are nullable/optional (no roster entry for the ward); menu_spending/sr311 are either the real per-ward shape or the {available: false, ...} honest-gap shape — both validated loosely (require data_tier, allow extra fields) rather than with oneOf, per the brief's judgment call.

safety.description: ward_safety_index record verbatim (incl. monthly) plus score_note and the caveat co-location blocks. additionalProperties true — passthrough. Every quotable number here carries its qualifier in its own object (windows.*, crash_trend) or as a `<field>_caveat` sibling (monthly, comparable_danger_score). See pipeline/caveats.py and claim.schema.json.

windows.description: The two 12-month crash windows. They are separate objects carrying separate blocks on purpose (CC-2): the recent window is provisional and the prior one has closed, so a single caveat over both would be false about one of them. Do not merge them.

alderman.description: null when no aldermen.json roster entry exists for this ward (see alderman_note).

alderman_note.description: OPTIONAL — present only when alderman is null.

menu_spending.description: Either {available: false, data_tier, note} (no Ward Wise data for this ward) or the real per-ward menu-spending record with data_tier added.

sr311.description: Either {available: false, data_tier, note} (no 311 entry for this ward) or the real per-ward 311 record with data_tier/note added.
